trans-unit.target: TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_00<tab>The expedition messenger wishes to speak with you.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_01<tab>At High Tide Harbor, the expedition messenger shares a summary of your Occult Crescent endeavors thus far. No sooner do you offer your seal of approval than he bids you return to the isle to see how Ketenramm and the crew are faring. Head swimming with imagery from your erstwhile adventures on the South Horn, you prepare for another voyage to those distant shores.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_02<tab>You find Ketenramm by the fountain, spirits high and enthusiasm for the expedition undiminished. He informs you that a route to the island's northern reaches has been established, and, eager to venture out, requests you speak with Jeffroy before departing.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_03<tab>As you discuss the path to the North Horn with Jeffroy and the others, a familiar voice cuts through the hubbub. Iris, the tiny faerie you encountered when first arriving on the island, floats forth and announces her wish to accompany you─albeit as a passive observer. Seeing no harm in this arrangement, Ketenramm quickly assents. Party thus augmented, your thoughts turn to the isle's next unexplored frontier...
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_TODO_00<tab>Speak with Ketenramm in the phantom village.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_TODO_01<tab>Speak with Jeffroy.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_001<tab>Funny you should show up now! I was just about to go over my expedition report.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_002<tab>With all that's happened, it's turned into quite the yarn, but perhaps you'd be willing to take a listen?
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_003<tab>Right, here goes.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_004<tab>“Plotting an eastward course from High Tide Harbor, Ketenramm and his veteran crew set forth for Shades' Triangle, resolved to uncover the mysteries of that treacherous stretch of ocean.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_005<tab>“After days of steady sailing, they at last laid eyes upon the Occult Crescent, but something strange was afoot. The isle shifted and shimmered like a mirage, confounding all attempts at approach. Just as the crew began to despair, an unknown force seized the ship, guiding it towards the island.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_006<tab>“According to daring adventurer and valued expedition member <var 2C ((<var 29 EB02 /var>)) (( )) 02 /var>, this occurred moments after a strange voice rang out in <var 08 E905 ((her)) ((his)) /var> mind. Though it remains unclear, it is plausible this mystery speaker and the ship-steering force are somehow linked.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_007<tab>“Once ashore, the crew entered the phantom village. Here, in one of its long-abandoned structures, they made a startling discovery: a wizened-but-welcoming old fellow called the Archive, seemingly afflicted with the tonberry curse.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_008<tab>“Learning of Ketenramm's plans, the Archive readily offered his expertise. Yet it soon became apparent that this expertise had been sealed away─the only means of recall being to hear what the adventurer saw and learned during <var 08 E905 ((her)) ((his)) /var> excursions.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_009<tab>“The mystery deepened further when Iris, a tiny familiar likely summoned by the isle's shadowy architect, appeared out of nowhere, prompting many questions but providing few answers. For now, she seems content to observe the expedition from a distance.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_010<tab>“As the crew explored more of these strange shores, a picture of the isle's true purpose began to take shape. By all accounts, it appears to be a repository for knowledge and monuments from the Fifth Astral Era.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_011<tab>“To keep these precious relics safe, the Occult Crescent is surrounded by a magical ward separating it from the outside world. Similar magicks are also believed to prevent the expedition's vessel leaving port.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_012<tab>“Among the island's ruins stand two spires: the Tower of Blood on the South Horn, and its northern counterpart, the Tower of Magic. While both are considered key to unraveling the isle's secrets, it is the latter in which the Occult Crescent's architect is thought to reside.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_013<tab>“An island-wide ward keeping knowledge within and interlopers without...
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_014<tab>“A mysterious entity capable of wielding such magicks... What will transpire when their true identity is unveiled?”
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_015<tab>...Or something along those lines. Did that sound all right to you?
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_016<tab>Huzzah! Thanks for listening. I'm sure there'll be plenty more to write about before the expedition ends.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_017<tab>I can't help but worry about the crew though...
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_018<tab>Say, why don't you go and pay them a visit? No doubt you'll be needed back on the isle sooner rather than later.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_019<tab>Excellent! I presume you'll be using the aetherial current like you usually do.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_020<tab>Give old Ketenramm my regards when you arrive!
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SAILOR05309_000_025<tab>Head back to the phantom village and see how old Ketenramm's faring, would you?
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_100<tab>Ah, good to see you, <var 2C ((<var 29 EB02 /var>)) (( )) 02 /var>.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_101<tab>I don't blame the fellow for feelin' concerned, but morale is high, despite us bein' trapped here.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_102<tab>And I've got good news besides. We've finally cleared a route to the north.

TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_103<tab>It took some doin', mind. Scramblin' across sheer cliffs, battlin' upstream through ragin' rapids, and wendin' our way through gloomy caves until we finally reached a basin of sorts.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_104<tab>We soon set up camp among some ruins, then set to work establishin' a path back here.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_105<tab>Anyroad, how about we head straight to the North Horn? With you back in the fold, we can get straight to work.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_106<tab>Good. I'll let the Archive know. We'll be waitin' over yonder by Jeffroy!
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_110<tab>Thanks to a few hastily constructed bridges and rope ladders, it's a fairly quick trip to the North Horn. Not that I'd call it the safest of routes...
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_ARCHIVE_000_115<tab>Unfortunately, the seal on my knowledge remains largely intact. Now that my eyes and ears are back, I look forward to chipping away at it with renewed vigor!
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_JEFFROY_000_200<tab>With the northern base camp up and running, we're ready to proceed at a moment's notice.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_JEFFROY_000_201<tab>That said, the usual precautions apply─we're better off sticking together en route.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_ARCHIVE_000_202<tab>I've not journeyed to the North Horn since emerging from the sarcophagus. I wonder what curiosities await!
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_IRIS_000_203<tab>I shall join you...
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_ARCHIVE_000_204<tab>Hohoh. A change of heart? Or perhaps new orders to help us?
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_IRIS_000_205<tab>...
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_IRIS_000_206<tab>I will simply be observing your companion.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_KETENRAMM_000_207<tab>Well, I suppose she has been keepin' an eye on us this whole while. Don't see any harm in her taggin' along.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_JEFFROY_000_208<tab>Right. When you're ready to depart, just say the word!
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SYSTEM_000_209<tab>New phantom jobs will be available on the Occult Crescent: North Horn.
